extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Introduction to the Anchoring Effect
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Definition of anchoring effect, reference points, numeric anchoring, non-numeric anchoring (length, weight, volume), psychophysics origins, end anchoring, Amos Tversky and Daniel Kahneman, 1974 seminal work, heuristic for estimates under uncertainty

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Experimental Evidence of Anchoring
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Tversky and Kahneman multiplication study (1x2x3x4x5x6x7x8 vs 8x7x6x5x4x3x2x1), UN African countries percentage study (roulette wheel 10 vs 65), Dan Ariely's social security number study (wine, chocolate, computer equipment), random generator/die roll replication failures, Case-Shiller House Price Index (2-year and 9-year highs), app-based stock brokerage first purchase price

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Characteristics of Anchoring Bias
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Difficulty of avoiding (Mahatma Gandhi age study, phone book physician study), failure of monetary incentives to mitigate bias, Consider-the-Opposite (COS) strategy, durability and longevity (one-week delay experiments, temperature targets), pervasiveness across contexts (legal sentencing, consumer purchasing, salary negotiations, forecasting), Furnham and Boo (2011)

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Anchoring in Groups and Automated Systems
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Group decision-making bias, discriminatory information communication, competing anchor hypothesis, impact of the first speaker, process accountability, competition vs cooperation, Business Intelligence (BI) systems, plausible vs spurious anchors, human susceptibility in technological systems

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Theories of Anchoring: Anchoring-and-Adjusting
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Tversky and Kahneman's anchoring-and-adjusting theory, insufficient adjustment, hindsight bias, egocentric bias, Epley and Gilovich's self-generated anchors, acceptable range, simulation theory of empathy, Tamir and Mitchell's self-other discrepancy

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Theories of Anchoring: Selective Accessibility and Attitude Change
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Selective accessibility theory, semantic priming, Strack and Mussweiler's absolute vs comparative judgments, integrative theory (Simmons and colleagues), attitude change view, confirmation of hypotheses, belief in the anchor

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Other Psychological Causes of Anchoring
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Extremeness aversion, Likert scale avoidance, maximum allowable adjustment effects, neuroscience basis, mixed-handed individuals and interhemispheric interaction, EEG studies (P2 and late positive potential amplitudes), fMRI and neural activation patterns for feasible vs infeasible anchors

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Factors Influencing Anchoring Susceptibility
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Cognitive ability (intelligence, cognitive reflection, aptitude for rationality), Predrag Teovanovic's research, overconfidence and cognitive conceit, Big Five personality traits (Conscientiousness, neuroticism, extraversion, openness, agreeableness), personal experience and expertise (judicial decisions, stock return estimates), motivation and rewards (Wegener's attitude change theory, high elaborative anchoring, Wilson et al. 1996), mood (sad vs happy/neutral, medical practitioners), culture (holistic vs analytic thinking, Poland vs India study, Hofstede's Uncertainty Avoidance Index)

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Anchoring in Negotiation
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Starting points and counter-anchors, influence of initial offers on outcomes, Strategic Negotiation Process Workshops, Northcraft and Neale's real-estate agent study, precision of anchors (general vs specific anchors, Janiszewski and Uy), scale of adjustment, first vs second anchor advantages and disadvantages

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Anchoring in Pricing and Consumer Behavior
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Price perception, sorting prices high to low (restaurant menus), decoy effect (inferior third choice, bundle sales, mixed bundles), incidental prices (uninterested products, auctions, online vendors)
